utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Dane, I heard the repair drive might be this weekend—did you catch anything about that?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I saw them setting up near the old oak tree early this morning. Looked pretty organized with some tools and a few people.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good, so it's definitely going ahead then. I'll try to swing by Saturday morning and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal, I'm so glad you're here! Quinn just told me the Hernandez family offered screws and hinges—those will be perfect for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that's wonderful, Mara! I was just about to check on the tool inventory. Do you know if they have any flathead screwdrivers too?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm not sure about flatheads, but I can ask Quinn if the Hernandez family had any tools to spare.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Saturday morning works for me. I'll swing by your place with the tools before then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday morning? Uh, sure, that sounds fine. Just knock loud, I might be in the backyard.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'll give a good loud knock. See you Saturday morning, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive — right, I almost forgot again! I think I have that old toaster in the garage somewhere. Should I bring it by?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, definitely bring the toaster! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4 — they'll have folks who can fix just about anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect! I'll dig it out of the garage tonight. Thanks for the reminder, Vik!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, I'm glad you're here! We're still collecting tools for the repair drive this Saturday—do you have anything you could lend?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? I still haven't seen any flyers or heard anyone else talk about it. Are you sure it's happening?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's definitely happening! Rosa's been organizing it, and I've been helping gather tools. I promise it's this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive? I've been telling everyone—it's going to be great! Do you have any old stuff lying around that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I haven't heard much about it. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: They're taking all sorts of things—old lamps, broken toasters, you name it! I even promised to bring in some spare screws and a fan I found in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works. I'll bring my socket set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great, Leo — just make sure you park in that overflow lot behind the old bakery, the main lot will be chaos.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to know. I'll park there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hana, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm planning to bring some old tools—do you think you could help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven't heard much yet—Dane mentioned they were setting up by the old oak tree this morning. Could you tell me more about what kind of tools you're bringing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I've got a few old wrenches and screwdrivers lying around—Opal said those would be especially handy. Do you have any tools you could dig up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey! I'm organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood this Saturday. Would you be able to help out?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Saturday? I think I'm free then. What kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great to hear! I could really use a hand with checking the tools and organizing them before folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Uli, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're collecting old electronics at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I heard Quinn mention it. Still trying to see what I can part with, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, and don't worry about parking — they're putting in an overflow lot behind the old bakery, so it should be fine!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, are you planning to join the repair drive? Do you have any tools we can use?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I was thinking of bringing my old push lawnmower—needs a new blade, but it'd be good to get it running again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: A lawnmower? That's not exactly what I had in mind for house repairs, but I guess we could use it for yard work. Do you have any basic tools like a hammer or screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, maybe I got that wrong. I just skimmed it somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Well, Opal mentioned she's working on an old GPS unit and could use a hand with the wiring. Maybe that's what you heard about?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, yeah, that could be it. Wiring stuff isn't really my thing, so I probably just skimmed past it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Well, I've been spreading the word like wildfire! But I still need to track down those spare parts—you wouldn't happen to have anything lying around, would you?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hang on, are you sure there's actually a repair drive happening? I haven't seen any official announcement or anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Well, I heard it from Mara who seemed pretty certain about it—maybe she's the one organizing things?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Vik, I just ran into Mina at the store—she was asking if I had tools for some repair drive this weekend. You know anything about that?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4! We're fixing up old bikes, furniture, electronics—the usual.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great! I've got a broken toaster I've been meaning to fix. Do I need to bring my own tools or will they be provided?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ah, Gus is on board for Saturday morning—good, that's shaping up to be a proper community affair.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, glad to hear Gus is helping out. So we're all set for Saturday morning then?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I'll have my old toolbox ready by 8 sharp—best to start early before the day heats up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'd like to hear more before I make up my mind—did you see anyone you recognized working on the drive, Faye?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, honestly—I've been trying to track down a clear schedule, but I keep getting mixed messages.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mixed messages, huh? That's exactly why I'm holding off—let's compare notes once we both have something solid.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Jules mentioned seeing a flyer at the café saying it's Saturday morning—so that lines up with what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right, Saturday morning—that's what I thought I saw. Thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No problem—glad we're on the same page. Should we see if anyone else nearby wants to join in?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it's this weekend, Nell—let me just double-check with Opal to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I saw them setting up near the old oak tree this morning—looked like they were getting ready for something.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, perfect, so it's definitely this weekend then. I'll grab my tools and head over to the oak tree.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Pia, are you here about the repair drive too? I think I'm supposed to be collecting tools or something, but it's all a bit fuzzy.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, I'm trying to figure out the details. I heard they've got overflow parking behind the old bakery, so at least that's one less thing to stress about.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Overflow parking? Huh, I hadn't heard that. I guess I should write that down somewhere before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Sam! I've got a few devices with frayed wires that could use your expertise. Let's start with the old radio.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey, I can help sort through the tools on Saturday morning. Just point me where.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Leo! Meet us at my garage around 9 AM on Saturday — I'll have the tools spread out on the workbench.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I suppose I could look around, but I'm not sure what I have that's fixable.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Maybe you could bring it over to Opal's place—they're working on an old GPS unit and might have tips for other fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure I'm up for going over there just now... maybe another time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: And they're even setting up an overflow lot behind the old bakery, so parking won't be an issue at all!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to know about the parking. Have you checked if we have enough tools for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'm not sure about tools — but my cousin mentioned they're hoping people will bring their own screwdrivers and such, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I was just saying I've got an old toaster that might be perfect for the repair drive. Do you think someone could fix it up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, bring it along! We've got folks who love tinkering with small appliances like that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I'll dig it out of the garage this evening. See you on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara. I've got some tools ready to go for that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh Gus, that's great to hear! I've been rounding up spare parts too—Quinn brought in some fans and hardware, so we're making good progress.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help out, Mara. Just say the word and I'll bring my toolbox over to Quinn's place.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
